# Classifier evaluation

*Python 3.12.3 on Linux x86_64. Generated by `eval/run_classifier.py`.*

**Read this first.** The expected labels were derived by reasoning (see `eval/dataset.py`),
not by two independent human annotators. So this is **agreement with construction labels on
39 programs (44 program/fairness cases)**, not accuracy. Verify every label by
hand (or double-annotate and report disagreements) before quoting precision/recall.

## Tier A (exhaustive search)

- Agreement with the labels: **44/44**
- Witnesses reproduced by the independent replay: **26/26**
- Template narrations accepted by the checker: **44/44**
- "Deadlock and race in one program" reports both findings: yes

| label | support | TP | FP | FN | precision | recall |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| safe | 18 | 18 | 0 | 0 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| race | 8 | 8 | 0 | 0 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| deadlock | 11 | 11 | 0 | 0 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| lost_signal | 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| starvation | 4 | 4 | 0 | 0 | 1.00 | 1.00 |

## Tier B (symmetry reduction) versus Tier A

Applies to 21 cases (programs with a non-trivial symmetry).
Same label and same witness length: **21/21**;
witnesses replay: **21/21**;
states A to B: dl_inversion_basic 19→11, dl_inversion_with_work 32→18, dl_inversion_unlock_order 17→10, dl_three_cycle 87→31, dl_dining_3 87→31, dl_dining_4 391→104, dl_and_race_together 30→17, safe_ordered_2 16→9, safe_single_lock_2 16→9, safe_single_lock_3 44→13, safe_readers_only 8→4, safe_private_variables 4→3, race_two_writers 4→3, race_read_modify_write 9→6, race_different_locks 16→10, race_loop_unprotected 25→15, safe_loop_locked 45→24, sem_binary_mutual_exclusion 16→9, sem_counting_two_permits 16→10, sem_two_semaphore_cycle 19→11, cond_two_waiters_one_signal 44→24.

## Tier C (PCT sampling): 20 seeds x 200 runs, depth 3

| expected bug | batches | found some failure | exact label |
|---|---|---|---|
| deadlock | 220 | 219/220 | 204/220 |
| race | 160 | 160/160 | 160/160 |
| lost_signal | 60 | 60/60 | 45/60 |

PCT stops at the FIRST failure it finds, so a program with several failure kinds may report
a different (also real, replay-verified) one; "exact label" counts only the expected kind.

False alarms on programs labelled safe or starvation (Tier C only looks for deadlock, race
and lost signal): **0/440** sampled batches. Tier C never returns
"safe": a batch that finds nothing is labelled `none_found`/`sampled`.
